summary: Re-tested after fix of CRITICAL bug from iter_99: athlete-team-selector is NOW persistent in the Plan Activo bar across all Datos sub-sections (DashboardPage.js line ~4047). TAREA 2 (team replication) FULLY verified end-to-end. TAREA 3 (bidirectional drag) partially verified: event creation in Plan Gráfico works (cell shows date), but drag-and-drop on Calendar could not be exercised in this session because gp_ chips did not appear after calendar prev-month navigation (likely calendar month did not advance to April 2026 where the event lives, or chip testid pattern differs). TAREA 1 (SessionEditor capacity unit change) was NOT reached in this session due to plan auto-deselecting when switching active athlete (Juan Perez has different assigned_plan_id).

integration_issues.issue: Could not validate drag in Calendar: after navigating to subnav-calendar-view, no event-chip-gp_* chips were visible. The Plan Gráfico cell-activities-training-6 correctly shows '15/04' after save (POST /api/events-calendar OK), so gp_ event exists in backend for the athlete, but it is not rendered in the calendar view shown by default (June 2026). Chevron-left navigation to previous month occasionally throws DOM-detached/timeout while month changes. Need either (a) auto-jump calendar to the event date when only one event exists, or (b) a stable [data-testid] on month-prev / month-next buttons in SessionCalendar.

Switching the persistent selector to an individual athlete (e.g. Juan Pérez, who has a different assigned_plan_id) causes the active plan to deselect (UI returns to 'Selecciona un Plan' welcome). This blocks navigation to section-tab-periodizacion when an individual athlete is chosen, because the section-tab buttons depend on an active plan. Either: (a) selector should NOT clear the active plan when switching athletes; OR (b) main agent must keep Team-mode for TAREA 1 too.

issues: Console warns repeatedly: DialogContent requires DialogTitle for screen-reader accessibility. Wrap titles or add VisuallyHidden where appropriate.
Console warn: 'A component is changing an uncontrolled input to be controlled' on date input inside comp-date-modal — initialize the value to '' instead of undefined.
Several '404 Failed to load resource' in console — investigate which static/asset 404s.

TAREA 2 STEP-BY-STEP: (1) Select team 'Selección Sub-17 (2)' from athlete-team-selector — badge 'Modo Equipo: 2 atletas' renders. (2) Navigate to Visualización → Plan Gráfico — banner [data-testid='graphic-team-mode-banner'] shows 'Modo Equipo · Selección Sub-17'. (3) Click cell-activities-training-6 → comp-date-modal opens. (4) Add date 2026-04-15 → Guardar. (5) TOAST shown: '1 fecha(s) añadida(s) al calendario · replicado a 2 atletas del equipo'. (6) Network confirms two POST /api/events-calendar calls (one per athlete in team) — replication backend-confirmed.

TAREA 3 PARTIAL: cell-activities-training-6 in Plan Gráfico correctly stores the date (cell text '15/04') after POST /api/events-calendar. Drag step itself NOT exercised due to calendar view issue above.
action_items: MEDIUM (TAREA 3): In SessionCalendar.js, add stable data-testid to prev/next month buttons (e.g. data-testid='calendar-prev-month'/'calendar-next-month') and consider auto-navigating the calendar to the closest month containing an event when the calendar opens. This blocks both manual UX and automated testing of the bidirectional drag.

MEDIUM (TAREA 1): The selector switch should NOT cause the active plan to deselect. In DashboardPage handler for athlete selection (around line 4059), do not unset activePlan when changing selectedAthleteId — just update the displayed athlete; keep the user inside the currently active plan.
LOW: Fix the Radix DialogContent accessibility warnings (DialogTitle missing) in comp-date-modal and SessionEditor modals.
LOW: Initialize the date input value in comp-date-modal to '' to silence the controlled-input warning.
LOW: 'Failed to load resource: 404' appears multiple times in console — locate the missing asset/API and fix or remove.
critical_code_review_comments: FIX VERIFIED: DashboardPage.js:4046–4095 — selector moved out of the welcome-only block to a persistent bar; renders whenever (athletes.length>0 || teams.length>0) AND a plan is active. Works as expected.

DashboardPage.js (athlete change handler around 4059–4061): switching selectedAthleteId via the selector may indirectly cause plan view to clear if the athlete's assigned_plan_id differs from the current activePlan.id. Verify that setSelectedAthleteId() does not trigger any effect that calls handleSetActivePlan(null) or filters plans list. This caused TAREA 1 to be unreachable in this run.
SessionCalendar.js: prev/next month buttons lack data-testid — add for testability.
GraphicPlan.js + DashboardPage: TAREA 2 replication works correctly (two POSTs to /api/events-calendar confirmed). No code changes needed.
